exactPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept game inventory assets, original Daoist chibi hand-painted style.
Create a true transparent RGBA sprite atlas, requested1536x1024, exactly THREE columns and TWO rows of equal square cells, six separate complete floating zodiac crystal bubble skins. Read left-to-right, top-to-bottom. They are inventory icons, not a finished world animation.
Input1 is source STRUCTURE/SEMANTIC reference only: six different zodiac glyphs and the color order. Preserve the understandable sign on each orb, small upper-left bubble neck, and round/softly oval orb identity. Do NOT copy the source pixel rendering, labels, grey board or the separate dark oval shadow UNDER each source orb. Inputs2 and3 are the approved jade/ivory/warm-gold Daoist chibi HAND-PAINTED visual style references only, not UI scenes or characters to draw.
The six objects form one refined original family: softly rounded translucent colored crystal sugar-bubbles, delicate fine painterly edge, soft hand-painted internal light, a slim warm-gold cloud-engraved rim, tiny jade-and-gold rounded neck at upper-left, subtle cloud curl INSIDE the glass, ONE large unmistakable warm ivory-gold zodiac glyph on the front. Colorful, cute, clean, crafted in jade/gold/crystal, not photoreal product renders or plastic3D. Glyphs remain clear at32px. Do not turn the transparent bubble into an opaque medal or a flat button. The glyph is central and visually dominant, no extra tiny glyphs or words.
Cell1 top-left: item1690 ARIES, blue/periwinkle crystal, exact Aries glyph ♈ (symmetric ram-horn fork).
Cell2 top-middle: item1691 TAURUS, amber-gold crystal, exact Taurus glyph ♉ (circle with upward curved horns).
Cell3 top-right: item1692 GEMINI, vermilion/coral crystal, exact Gemini glyph ♊ (two upright joined pillars, horizontal curved caps).
Cell4 bottom-left: item1693 CANCER, fresh jade/emerald crystal, exact Cancer glyph ♋ (opposed paired curls,69-like).
Cell5 bottom-middle: item1694 LEO, honey-gold crystal, exact Leo glyph ♌ (small round loop opening into a tall curved tail).
Cell6 bottom-right: item1695 VIRGO, turquoise crystal, exact Virgo glyph ♍ (three rounded m-like stems with inward loop on the right; no arrow).
Same perspective and object scale in every cell. The complete orb INCLUDING neck roughly340–390px wide in a512px cell, with at least50px truly clear alpha margins on every side and large empty gaps. No pixel crosses a cell boundary. No labels, numbers, Chinese text, letters, UI cards, background, floor, pedestal, selection plate, ground shadow, floating dust or fog. No diffuse glow outside the object. All unused pixels including every gap and the entire exterior background are genuinely transparent. Highest host-provided detail and clean antialiasing.
